title: Morning Cybersecurity Digest
subtitle: Saturday, September 19 — Here's what's worth your attention today.

items.title: Cisco ISE Zero-Day CVE-2026-76460
items.summary: Cisco ISE zero-day CVE-2026-76460 has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is being actively exploited. No workaround is available.
items.details: Fixed releases include 3.1 Patch 12, 3.2 Patch 11, 3.3 Patch 12, 3.4 Patch 7, and 3.5 Patch 4. The KEV remediation deadline for federal agencies is September 19, 2026.
items.action: Patch immediately and restrict the management interface with iACLs where possible.

items.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway CVE-2026-76461
items.summary: CVE-2026-76461 was added to the KEV catalog and its remediation deadline was September 18, 2026.
items.details: Patching alone may not remove an established compromise. Review systems for suspicious usernames and API activity in logs.
items.action: Patch affected systems and perform compromise-hunting activities.

items.title: Pixel Modem Zero-Day CVE-2026-58704
items.summary: CVE-2026-58704 is a Pixel modem zero-day with a KEV remediation deadline of September 19, 2026.
items.details: The September Pixel security update includes the required fixes.
items.action: Deploy the September Pixel bulletin with the 2026-09-05 patch level and verify compliance through MDM.

items.title: Qilin Lists Inland and Offshore Contractors
items.summary: Qilin listed Inland and Offshore Contractors of Trinidad and Tobago on its leak site on September 18.
items.details: The organization operates in the energy and utilities sector.

items.title: Play Lists Barrett Mahony Consulting Engineers
items.summary: Play listed Barrett Mahony Consulting Engineers of Ireland on its leak site on September 18.
items.details: The organization operates in the professional services sector.

items.title: Panzer Ransomware Activity
items.summary: Panzer, a newly observed ransomware group, has reportedly claimed 16 victims across 11 countries.
items.details: August recorded 997 known ransomware attacks, reported as a 23% increase from July.

items.title: Overdue KEV Vulnerabilities
items.summary: LiteLLM, Starlette and VMware vCenter remain on the board of vulnerabilities associated with known ransomware activity.

items.title: ₹12.84-Crore Hero FinCorp Heist
items.summary: Delhi Police IFSO arrested five people, including a bank relationship manager, over 317 unauthorized transactions.
items.details: ₹1.7 crore was reportedly put on hold. Investigators are examining a Dubai connection, Telegram groups linked to Chinese actors, and USDT conversion.

items.title: Noida Fintech Server Hack
items.summary: ₹2.42 crore was reportedly siphoned through 497 transactions within eight hours.
items.details: The funds were distributed across 58 accounts in 28 banks before the activity was detected.

items.title: CISF and IIT Kanpur DFIR Training
items.summary: CISF signed an MoU with IIT Kanpur's C3iHub for six-week residential training.
items.details: The program focuses on digital forensics, incident response and critical-infrastructure security.

items.title: Fraudulent SIM Supply Chain Investigation
items.summary: Eight people were arrested as part of an investigation into a fraudulent SIM supply chain.
